# bitt database tour (generated by scripts/v2_tour.py; synthetic data)

Connect: `psql postgresql://bitt@localhost:55432/bitt_tour` (the throwaway cluster; `scripts/pg_throwaway.sh start`).
Design: `docs/v2/db.md`. Every table below was written through the record (registered columns, FKs, append-only).

### 1. The tables: raw imports, and one made table per output contract (shared by every task), each with __src and __sets

```sql
SELECT schema, name, kind, sources FROM bitt.table WHERE schema IN ('raw', 'made') ORDER BY schema, name
```

| schema | name | kind | sources |
|---|---|---|---|
| made | answer | output | {} |
| made | answer__sets | sets | {'rows': 'made.answer'} |
| made | answer__src | src | {'set': 'bitt.set', 'src': 'any'} |
| made | clean | output | {} |
| made | clean__sets | sets | {'rows': 'made.clean'} |
| made | clean__src | src | {'set': 'bitt.set', 'src': 'any'} |
| made | length | output | {} |
| made | length__sets | sets | {'rows': 'made.length'} |
| made | length__src | src | {'set': 'bitt.set', 'src': 'any'} |
| made | rate | output | {} |
| made | rate__sets | sets | {'rows': 'made.rate'} |
| made | rate__src | src | {'set': 'bitt.set', 'src': 'any'} |
| raw | support_questions | raw | {} |
| raw | support_questions__sets | sets | {'rows': 'raw.support_questions'} |

### 3. The sets: the import, each run's input and output, the dataset, the ladder's rungs

A rung, a split or a test side makes no table: only a `bitt.set` row (a rung is the first k members of its parent).

```sql
SELECT left(bitt_set_hash, 12) AS set, tbl, kind, n, left(parent, 12) AS parent, k FROM bitt.set ORDER BY tbl, kind, n DESC
```

### 5. Lineage: an answer's length verdict back to the raw question, through __src

`bitt data inspect` walks this for you; here it is by hand. Rows are keyed by what they read, so two questions that clean to the same text share one answer row.

```sql
SELECT r.id, r.question AS raw_question, q.clean, a.answer, ok.length_ok
FROM made.length ok
JOIN made.length__src l3 ON l3.bitt_in_hash = ok.bitt_in_hash
JOIN made.answer a ON a.bitt_row_hash = l3.bitt_src_hash
JOIN made.answer__src l2 ON l2.bitt_in_hash = a.bitt_in_hash
JOIN made.clean q ON q.bitt_row_hash = l2.bitt_src_hash
JOIN made.clean__src l1 ON l1.bitt_in_hash = q.bitt_in_hash
JOIN raw.support_questions r ON r.bitt_row_hash = l1.bitt_src_hash
ORDER BY r.id LIMIT 6
```

| id | raw_question | clean | answer | length_ok |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| q000 |   How do I delete my file?   | how do i delete my file? | To how do i delete my file?: open settings. | True |
| q001 |   How do I reset my file?   | how do i reset my file? | To how do i reset my file?: open settings. | True |
| q002 |   How do I delete my file?   | how do i delete my file? | To how do i delete my file?: open settings. | True |
| q003 |   How do I share my file?   | how do i share my file? | To how do i share my file?: open settings. | True |
| q004 |   How do I share my account?   | how do i share my account? | To how do i share my account?: open settings. | True |
| q005 |   How do I export my account?   | how do i export my account? | To how do i export my account?: open settings. | True |

### 6. An aggregate: the `rate` module's one row over the check's run (per unit, with its 95% interval)

A check writes per-row verdicts only; anything across rows is a module that writes its own row into its own table.

```sql
SELECT rate, lo, hi, n, left(bitt_recipe_hash, 12) AS work, left(bitt_run_hash, 12) AS run FROM made.rate
```

| rate | lo | hi | n | work | run |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 0.757499 | 1 | 12 | 503759a30c04 | 83a97c5f2574 |

### 7. A dataset: its members and splits (a set over the raw rows)

```sql
SELECT m.ord, m.split, r.id FROM bitt.set s JOIN raw.support_questions__sets m ON m.bitt_set_hash = s.bitt_set_hash
JOIN raw.support_questions r USING (bitt_row_hash) WHERE s.kind = 'dataset' ORDER BY m.ord LIMIT 6
```

| ord | split | id |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | test | q000 |
| 1 | train | q001 |
| 2 | train | q002 |
| 3 | train | q003 |
| 4 | test | q004 |
| 5 | train | q005 |

### 8. Names (docs/v2/names.md) and tags: every name, the line it names, its version

A name is a `name` node bound to a line's root; versions and aliases are `tag` nodes on the unchanged thing.

```sql
SELECT v.ns = '' AS is_task, bitt.name_of(v.target) AS ref, v.class, v.kind, (SELECT count(*) FROM bitt.members(v.target)) AS members
FROM bitt.v_name v ORDER BY v.ns = '' DESC, v.ns, v.name
```

| is_task | ref | class | kind | members |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| True | demo | task | goal | 1 |
| False | demo/qa | data | dataset | 1 |
| False | lib/answer | type | artifact | 1 |
| False | lib/clean | type | module | 1 |
| False | lib/echo | type | module | 1 |
| False | lib/length | type | module | 1 |
| False | lib/rate | type | module | 1 |
| False | lib/split_by_id | type | module | 1 |
| False | raw/support_questions | data | raw | 1 |

### 9. bitt.resolve(): the kernel's resolver in SQL

```sql
SELECT r AS ref, (SELECT kind FROM bitt.node WHERE id = bitt.resolve(r)) AS kind, bitt.name_of(bitt.resolve(r)) AS line,
       bitt.version_of(bitt.resolve(r)) AS version
FROM unnest(ARRAY['raw/support_questions', 'raw/support_questions@1', 'demo', 'demo/qa', 'demo/qa@1.0', 'lib/clean']) r
```

| ref | kind | line | version |
|---|---|---|---|
| raw/support_questions | raw | raw/support_questions |  |
| raw/support_questions@1 | raw | raw/support_questions |  |
| demo | goal | demo |  |
| demo/qa | dataset | demo/qa | 1.0 |
| demo/qa@1.0 | dataset | demo/qa | 1.0 |
| lib/clean | module | lib/clean |  |

### 10. A task's own rows (A23): `<task>.<name>` views over the shared made tables

Every task gets a schema of its name and a view per made table: the rows its runs made or reused.

```sql
SELECT 'demo.answer' AS view, count(*) FROM demo.answer UNION ALL SELECT 'made.answer', count(*) FROM made.answer
```

| view | count |
|---|---|
| demo.answer | 8 |
| made.answer | 8 |

### 11. bitt.tree(): the graph as a branch tree

What was made from a raw line (`'up'` = what a node was made from). Every node once, under the data it was made from first; events, checks, names and jobs left out unless `hide` says otherwise.

```sql
SELECT line FROM bitt.tree('raw/support_questions')
```
